Detail levels that can never appear in the BMF

Source: R/recipient-type.R
pf_oos_details.Rd

The BMF lists US exempt organizations, so only foreign geography is truly disqualifying: an organization in London or Cape Town has no BMF row whatever its tax status.

Usage

pf_oos_details()

Value

A character vector of recipient_type_detail values.

Details

individual and government are deliberately not here, though an earlier version of this package did exclude them. Auditing 100 out-of-sample cases showed the exclusion was wrong 24% of the time, because column (c) reports the status of the grant's beneficiary while the check is written to the payee. A foundation paying a named student's tuition codes the grant I, and the payee is a university that is plainly in the BMF; filers also code ordinary 501(c)(3)s as GOV when they are university- or school-adjacent. Both are now carried as flags (flag_individual, flag_government) and matched anyway. See dev/AUDIT-FINDINGS.md.
